title: Validate calibration draft transitions
description: Implement pure calibration-draft transitions that recheck prerequisites, return structured actionable refusals, and preserve the exact prior state whenever an action is rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Each allowed action validates all prerequisites for its current state
Out-of-order, incomplete, or incompatible actions return stable reason codes and corrective actions
Rejected transitions return no effects and leave the input draft deeply unchanged
Accepted transitions return the next state and an explicit bounded effect request

steps.details: Add accepted and refused result variants with stable reason codes, affected fields, corrective actions, and optional effect requests.
Handle each TASK-92 action as a pure operation that validates state-specific prerequisites before constructing a new draft.
Represent persistence and artifact generation as requests emitted only by accepted transitions; do not execute effects in the state machine.
Cover valid paths, every out-of-order action, missing prerequisites, stable reasons, immutability, and absence of effects on refusal.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement the transition table and focused contract tests only.
Do not encode suitability thresholds or correction policy in transition guards.
